कु + -मन्त्रः

 राज्ञा तु निर्भया लोकाः Bhāg. 10. 21. 47.
कु + -मेरुः The southern hemisphere or pole.

कुमारः [cf. Uṇ. 3. 138]
—1 A son, boy; a youth; यदात्थ राजन्यकुमार तत्तथा यशस्तु रक्ष्यं
 परतो यशोधनैः R. 3. 48.
—2 A boy below five.
—3 A prince, an heir-apparent (especially in dramas); विप्रोषितकुमारं
 तद्राज्यमस्तमितेश्वरम् R. 12. 11; कुमारस्यायुषो बाणः V. 5; उपवेष्टुमर्हति
 कुमारः Mu. 4 (said by Rākṣasa to Malayaketu).
—4 N. of Kārtikeya, the god of war; कुमारकल्पं सुषुवे कुमारम् R. 5. 36;
 कुमारोऽपि कुमारविक्रमः 3. 55.
—5 N. of Agni.
—6 A parrot.
—7 N. of the author of a Dharmaśāstra.

कुमारः + .{@-रम्@} pure gold.
.━{@Comp.@}: कुमारजीवः, कुमारपालनः, कुमारभृत्या, कुमारललिता, कुमारलीढः, कुमारवाहिन्, कुमारवाहनः, कुमारव्रतम्, कुमारसूः, कुमारसंभवम्
कुमारः + -जीवः N. of the plant पुत्रंजीव.

कुमारः + -पालनः
—1 one who takes care of children.
—2 N. of king Śālivāhana.

कुमारः + -भृत्या
—1 care of young children.
—2 care of a woman in pregnancy or confinement, midwifery; कुमारभृत्याकुशलैरनुष्ठिते
 भिषग्भिराप्तैरथ गर्भभर्मणि R. 3. 12.

कुमारः + -ललिता f.
—1 delicate love-dalliance.
—2 N. of a metre consisting of seven syllables in a quarter.
कुमारः + -लीढः also कुब्जालीढः N. of the founder of a sect.

कुमारः + -वाहिन्, -वाहनम्^1 a peacock.

कुमारः + -व्रतम् a vow of eternal celibacy.

कुमारः + -सूः f.
—1 an epithet of Pārvati.
—2 N. of the Ganges. ━(m.) an epithet of Agni.
कुमारः + -संभवम् N. of Kalidāsaʼs epic.

—1 A child, a youth; नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः Rv. 8. 30. 1.
—2 The pupil of the eye.
कुमारयति Den. P. [कुमार इव आचरति] To play, sport (like a child).
कुमारयुः A prince, heir-apparent.

कुमारिक a. (-की f.)
 Furnished with girls, abounding in girls.

कुमारिका, कुमारी
—1 A young girl, one from 10 to 12 years old.
—2 A maiden, virgin; त्रीणि वर्षाण्युदीक्षेत कुमार्यृतुमती सती Ms. 9. 90, 11. 59;
 व्यावर्ततान्योपगमात्कुमारी R. 6. 69.
—3 A girl or daughter in general.
—4 N. of Durgā.
—5 N. of several plants (Mar. कोरफड, कर्टोली, कांटेशेवंती, बटमोगरा इ).
—6 N. of Sītā.
—7 Large cardamoms.
—8 The southern extremity of the Indian peninsula (cf. the modern name Cape Comorin).
.━{@Comp.@}: कुमारिकापुत्रः, कुमारिकापुरम्, कुमारिकाश्वशुरः

कुमारिका + -पुत्रः
—1 the son of an unmarried woman.
—2 N. of Karṇa.

कुमारिका + -पुरम् a gymansium or a girlʼs apartment. अपुंस्त्वमप्यस्य निशम्य

कुमालकः N. of a country, a Taluka in the Mālava country (सौवीरदेश ?).

कुमुद् a.
—1 Unkind, unfriendly.
—2 Avaricious. ━n.
—1 The white water-lily.
—2 The red lotus.

कुमुदः, -दम्
 [कौ भोदते इति कुमुदम्]
—1 The white water-lily said to open at moon-rise [Nymphea alba] नोच्छ्वसिति

—2 A red lotus.

कुमुदः, -दम् + .{@-दः@}
—1 An epithet of Viṣṇu.
—2 N. of the elephant supposed to guard the south.
—3 Camphor.
—4 A species of monkey.
—5 N. of a Nāga who gave his younger sister कुमुद्वती to Kuśa, son
 of Rāma; see R. 16. 79, 86.

कुमुदिक a.
—1 Abounding in Kumudas.

कुमुदिक + .{@-का@} N. of a plant (कट्फला).
—2 A small tree (the seeds of which are aromatic).

—1 A water-lily with white lotus flowers; यथेन्दावानन्दं व्रजति समुपोढे
 कुमुदिनी U. 5. 26; Śi. 9. 34.
—2 A collection of lotuses.
—3 A place abounding in lotuses.

कुमुदिनी + -नायकः, -पतिः ━m. The moon; दृष्ट्वा कुमुद्वन्तमखण्डमण्डलम् Bhāg. 10. 29.

कुमुद्वत् + .{@-ती@}
—1 A water-lily with white flowers (opening at moon-rise); अन्तर्हिते

 कुमुद्वती भानुमतीव भावम् (न बबन्ध) R. 6. 36. कुमुद्वती

—2 A collection of lotuses.
—3 A place abounding in lotuses.

कुम्पः A cripple in the arms.

—1 A kind of head-dress for women (?) कुरीरमस्य शीर्षणि कुम्बं चाधिनिदध्मसि Av. 6. 138. 3.
—2 The upper part of a club.

कुम्बः + .{@-बा@}
—1 A thick petticoat.

कुम्भः [कुं भूमिं कुत्सितं वा उम्भति पूरयति उम्भ्-अच् शकं˚ Tv.]
—1 A pitcher, water-pot, jar; इयं सुस्तनी मस्तकन्यस्तकुम्भा Jag.;
 वर्जयेत्तादृशं मित्रं विषकुम्भं पयोमुखम् H. 1. 74; R. 2. 36;
[]
 so कुच˚, स्तन˚.
—2 The frontal globe on the forehead of an elephant; इभकुम्भ Māl. 5. 32;
 मत्तेभकुम्भदलने भुवि सन्ति शूराः Bh. 1. 59.
—3 Aquarius, the eleventh sign of the zodiac.
—4 A measure of grain equal to 20 droṇas; धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो
 हरतोऽभ्यधिकं वधः Ms. 8. 320.
—5 (In Yoga phil.) Closing the nostrils and mouth so as to suspend breathing.
—6 The paramour of a harlot.
—7 An urn in which the bones of dead bodies are collected.
—8 A kind of heart-disease.
—9 N. of a plant (and also of its fruit); क्वचिद् बिल्वैः क्वचित्कुम्भैः
 क्वचिच्चामलकमुष्टिभिः Bhāg. 10. 18. 14.
कुम्भः + .{@-भा@} A harlot, a whore.

कुम्भः + .{@-भम्@} A fragrant resin (गुग्गुल).

कुम्भः + -उदरः one of the attendants of Śiva; अवेहि मां किङ्करमष्टमूर्तेः
 कुम्भोदरं नाम निकुम्भमित्रम् R. 2. 35.

कुम्भः + -उलूकः a kind of owl; हृत्वा पिष्टमयं पूपं कुम्भोलूकः प्रजायते
 Mb. 13. 111. 101.
कुम्भः + -उलूखलकम् a medicinal plant (Mar. गुग्गुळ).

कुम्भः + -कर्णः ‘pitcher-eared’, N. of a gigantic Rākṣasa, a brother
 of Rāvaṇa and slain by Rāma. [He is said to have devoured thousands
 of beings including sages and heavenly nymphs, and the gods were anxiously
 waiting for an opportunity to retaliate upon the powerful demon. After
 Brahmā had inflicted on him a curse for the humiliation to which he subjected
 Indra and his elephant Airāvata, Kumbhakarṇa began to practise the most
 rigid austerities. Brahmā was pleased and was about to grant him a boon,
 when the gods requested Sarasvatī to sit on his tongue and to pervert
 it. Accordingly when he went to the god, instead of asking Indrapada
 he asked Nidrāpada which was readily granted. It is said that
 he slept for six months at a time, and, when roused, was awake for only
 one day. When Lankā was besieged by the monkey-troops of Rāma, Ravāṇa
 with great difficulty roused Kumbhakarṇa, desirous of availing himself
 of his gigantic strength. After having drunk 2000 jars of liquor, he took
 Sugrīva prisoner, besides devouring thousands of monkeys. He was ultimately
 slain by Rāma.] Rām. 6; R. 12. 80.
—2 an epithet of Śiva; Mb. 12.
कुम्भः + -कामला a bilious affection.

कुम्भः + -कारः
—1 a potter; मृद्दण्डचक्रसंयोगात्कुम्भकारो यथा घटम् (करोति) Y. 3. 146.
—2 a mixed tribe (वेश्यायां विप्रतश्चौर्यात् कुम्भकारः स उच्यते Uśanas;
 or मालाकारात्कर्मकर्यां कुम्भकारो व्यजायत Parāśara).
—3 a serpent.
—4 a kind of wild fowl.
कुम्भः + -घोणः N. of a town.
कुम्भः + -दासी a bawd, procuress; sometimes used as a term of reproach or abuse.
कुम्भः + -धरः the sign ef the zodiac called Aquarius.
कुम्भः + -पञ्जरः a niche in the wall.
कुम्भः + -राशिः the sign Aquarius.
कुम्भः + -रेतस् m. a form of Agni.

कुम्भः + -लग्नम् that time of the day in which Aquarius rises above the horizon.
[]

कुम्भः + -मण्डूकः
—1 (lit.) a frog in a pitcher.
—2 (fig.) an inexperienced man; cf. कूपमण्डूक.
कुम्भः + -शाला pottery.

कुम्भः + -सन्धिः the hollow on the top of an elephantʼs head between the

—2 A harlot.
—3 A disease of the eyes.

—1 An elephant; असौ कुम्भिभ्रान्त्या खरनखरविद्रावितमहागुरुग्रावग्रामः

कुम्भिन् + -नरकः a particular hell.
कुम्भिन् + -मदः rut, ichor.
